Fernhill Garden Nursery

We grow perennials, fruit trees and native hedging outdoors, and sell them from the nursery gate from March to November.

Bare-root hedging

Beech, hawthorn and hornbeam whips are lifted in November and sold bare-root until March, when the soil is workable.

Fruit trees

Apples, pears and plums on dwarfing rootstocks, grafted here and grown on for two years before sale.

Our compost is supplied by Valley Compost, who sponsor the spring open day.
